    padding: 40px 0;

}

nav.elementor-pagination a{
    border: 1px solid var( --e-global-color-primary ) !important;
    border-radius: 4px  !important;
    padding: 8px 12px !important;
}

nav.elementor-pagination a:hover{
    color: #fff !important;
        background-color: var( --e-global-color-primary ) !important;
}

/********************
** Carruseles
*********************/

.elementor-loop-container .elementor-swiper-button {
    border: 1px solid var( --e-global-color-primary ) !important;
}
.elementor-loop-container .elementor-swiper-button svg {
    color: var( --e-global-color-primary ) !important;
    fill: var( --e-global-color-primary ) !important;
}

/** MOBILE VERSION **********************/
@media (max-width:1024.98px){ 
    /** Sections **/
    .section {
        max-width: 100% !important;
        padding: 0 40px 80px !important;
       /* border: 1px solid red !important;*/
      }

}

@media (max-width:766.95px){ 

    /** Typography **/
    h1{
        font-size: 40px !important;
    }
    h2{
        font-size: 32px  !important;
    }
    .loop-carrusel.loop-blog h2{
        font-size: 24px  !important;
    }

    /** Titles **/

    .title-border-left,
    .title-border-left-right,
    .title-border-right{
        text-align: left !important;
        padding: 32px !important;
       /* border: 1px solid blue !important;*/
    } 
    /** Sections **/
    .section {
        padding: 0 40px 80px !important;
       /*  border: 1px solid black !important;*/
      }
      .section .section{
        padding: 0 !important;
      }
      
}

/********************
** Casos éxito
*********************/

.rank-math-breadcrumb p {
        margin-bottom: 0px !important;
        line-height: 14px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow-x: auto;
}
.breadcrumb {
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.breadcrumb__news, .breadcrumb__news a, .breadcrumb__news .separator, .breadcrumb__news a:hover {
    color: #F7F7FB;font-size: 12px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.breadcrumb__news a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

.z-index-1, .z-index-1 > * {
    z-index: -1 !important;
}


.breadcrumb__base, .breadcrumb__base a, .breadcrumb__base .separator, .breadcrumb__base a:hover {
    color: #0E092B;font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.breadcrumb__base a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
/*QUITAR BOLAS Y AJUSTES*/
body .elementor-widget.elementor-widget-spacer.elementor-motion-effects-parent.animated {
  display: none !important;
}
body .elementor-widget-spacer .elementor-motion-effects-element  {
  display: none !important;
}
 
@media(max-width: 767px) {
  body .swiper-pagination.swiper-pagination-clickable.swiper-pagination-bullets.swiper-pagination-horizontal {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

.elementor-widget-spacer.elementor-absolute.elementor-motion-effects-parent {
    display:none !important;
